title: Product review: DR.ÖTEK MT-12 metal detector. (New for 2025)
description:
Today we take a look at a new budget-friendly metal detector from DR.ÖTEK. The MT-12.

Over the next few months, I hope to review a few other detectors in the $100-$200 price range to show more options for those on a tight budget, new to the hobby, or both.
